title: Session Keeper
what: A cache bar above the prompt with rewrite and session cost, a smart next-command button, a hold on cold-cache messages, and a device-aware handoff

parts.label: Cache bar above the prompt (cache, context, rewrite $, session $, 5 hrs, week)
Animated Claude crab on the bar
Smart button that suggests the best command right now
Hold my message when the cache has gone cold and show the cost first
Offer a handoff when the chat gets long
